description: This file defines a custom exception class 'HolidayNotFoundException' used in the Fineract project to indicate that a holiday resource was not found. It extends a base exception class and provides constructors that include error messages and handles the case where a holiday ID does not correspond to an existing resource.
external_methods: super(String errorCode, String defaultUserMessage, Object... parameters)
